group: Day in Court Team 3

# The law project's policy

The agent that lives in this folder reads the project's WhatsApp group and never writes there. `group:` above is the
group's name exactly as WhatsApp shows it in the chat list: change it if it is not "Day in Court Team 3".
Every rule here starts in watch (http://127.0.0.1:7777/agent/law-project). Whatever the mode, a reply is only ever
a draft: you copy it and send it yourself.

- [watch, draft] gc: every 30 min 08:00–23:00 read the group since the last look into chat-log.md; keep owed.md (what I was asked, what I promised, by when, who waits); where an answer from me is due, a draft in drafts.md and a card with its text, and "copied" when I have sent it myself.
- [watch] clock: 21:00 "where the project stands" in five lines, from owed.md and chat-log.md, in made/<date>-stands.md.
